column1: # cfd-territory never-run census -- generated by scripts/census_never_run.py
# unit: directory D with D/system/controlDict (INSTANCE) or D/system/controlDict*.template (DEFINITION); plus the orphan
#       unit: a directory with solver logs and NO system/ (a case run then pruned) -> RAN_LOGS_ONLY
# NEVER_RUN predicate: no solver log with an 'ExecutionTime = ' line, no time dir > 0 with content (case level OR processor*/),
#                      and no mesh (constant/polyMesh/points or a mesh-utility log).
# family is NAME-DERIVED and is a navigation aid only -- it cannot reliably pair a definition under cases/ with its
# outputs under verification/runs/, and it collides (cases/tmr and models/tmr share the key 'tmr').
# verdict_artifact is NAME-LINKED and is the weakest column here; open it before relying on it.
# tree=out_of_git rows come from stores enumerated in docs/LOCATIONS.md and reconciled against the disk; those stores are LAB-WIDE, not cfd-only.
# physics and bookkeeping are INDEPENDENT columns and are never folded into the class: ENDTIME_FIELDS/ABSENT is a solve whose log is gone, NONE/COMPLETE is a log whose fields are gone.

# RESIDUAL LIMIT: an in-repo case whose work happened out of git with NO recorded remote_dir is classified on its own artifacts alone and can still read NEVER_RUN. Name-matching would close that and reintroduce the F1-vs-F17 false negative; such rows are adjudicated by hand.
